description: Read stored facts for one to four exact Commander case or deck products on one shared source-date window. Resolve numeric IDs with spellbook_sealed_product_search first. Returns per-product kind, market price and clock, publication revision and readiness, plus contributor rows with finish, quantity, USD Full EV contribution, aligned source-recorded units and missing-versus-zero state, a comparisonRevision, missingFields and limitations. A stale or absent input, empty window intersection, invalid mapping, missing exact card price or oversized input leaves a product not ready and the response names the gap. A missing catalog market price or clock appears in missingFields and leaves readiness unchanged, because the caller supplies the purchase price. Page with offset, limit and nextOffset; a changed revision requires restarting at offset 0.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

limit.description: Contributor rows per response, default 20, maximum 100. Whole-comparison totals and the shared window stay unchanged.

offset.description: Contributor offset, starting at zero. Follow nextOffset to inspect every contributor.

productIds.description: One to four distinct numeric Commander product IDs, comma separated, for example 1001,1002.

revision.description: comparisonRevision from a prior page. A changed revision requires restarting at offset 0.

name: spellbook_commander_comparison_facts
